001package com.streamConverter.path;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Arrays;
005import java.util.Collections;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Objects;
008
009/**
010 * Simplified tree path class for hierarchical path matching.
011 *
012 * <p>This class provides simple path matching against List&lt;String&gt; hierarchical paths. It
013 * supports both JSON-style ("$.user.name") and XML-style ("user/name") path formats.
014 */
015public class TreePath extends AbstractPath<List<String>> {
016
017  // Internal hierarchical representation as simple string list
018  private final List<List<String>> pathSegmentsList;
019  private final String originalPath;
020
021  // === Constructors ===
022
023  /**
024   * Private constructor for internal use by factory methods
025   *
026   * @param pathExpression Path expression
027   */
028  private TreePath(String pathExpression) {
029    super(pathExpression);
030    this.originalPath = pathExpression;
031    this.pathSegmentsList = Collections.singletonList(parsePathToSegments(pathExpression));
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Creates TreePath from multiple paths (OR condition)
036   *
037   * @param pathList List of path expressions
038   */
039  public TreePath(List<String> pathList) {
040    super(String.join(",", pathList));
041    if (pathList == null || pathList.isEmpty()) {
042      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path list cannot be null or empty");
043    }
044    this.originalPath = String.join(",", pathList);
045    List<List<String>> temp = new ArrayList<>();
046    for (String path : pathList) {
047      temp.add(parsePathToSegments(path));
048    }
049    this.pathSegmentsList = Collections.unmodifiableList(temp);
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Creates TreePath from JSON format path
054   *
055   * @param jsonPath JSON format path (e.g., "$.user.name", "$.items.title")
056   * @return TreePath instance
057   */
058  public static TreePath fromJsonPath(String jsonPath) {
059    return new TreePath(jsonPath);
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Creates TreePath from XML format path
064   *
065   * @param xmlPath XML format path (e.g., "user/name", "items/title")
066   * @return TreePath instance
067   */
068  public static TreePath fromXmlPath(String xmlPath) {
069    return new TreePath(xmlPath);
070  }
071
072  // === AbstractPath Implementation ===
073
074  @Override
075  protected void validateAndNormalize(String rawPath) {
076    if (rawPath == null || rawPath.trim().isEmpty()) {
077      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null or empty");
078    }
079  }
080
081  @Override
082  public boolean matches(List<String> currentPath) {
083    if (currentPath == null) {
084      return false;
085    }
086
087    // OR condition: return true if any path matches
088    for (List<String> pathSegments : pathSegmentsList) {
089      if (pathSegments.equals(currentPath)) {
090        return true;
091      }
092    }
093    return false;
094  }
095
096  // === Internal Implementation ===
097
098  private List<String> parsePathToSegments(String pathExpression) {
099    String trimmed = pathExpression.trim();
100
101    if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {
102      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path expression cannot be empty");
103    }
104
105    // Parse as JSON-style path if starts with "$"
106    if (trimmed.startsWith("$")) {
107      return parseJsonPathToSegments(trimmed);
108    }
109
110    // Parse as slash-separated path if contains "/"
111    if (trimmed.contains("/")) {
112      return parseXmlPathToSegments(trimmed);
113    }
114
115    // Single segment path
116    return List.of(trimmed);
117  }
118
119  private List<String> parseJsonPathToSegments(String jsonPath) {
120    // Handle root path
121    if ("$".equals(jsonPath)) {
122      return new ArrayList<>();
123    }
124
125    // Handle array syntax preservation for JsonFilterCommand compatibility
126    if (jsonPath.contains("[")) {
127      // For complex paths with arrays, preserve original parsing logic
128      // This ensures JsonFilterCommand continues to work
129      return parseComplexJsonPath(jsonPath);
130    }
131
132    // Simple property paths: $.property or $.nested.property
133    if (jsonPath.startsWith("$.")) {
134      String pathWithoutRoot = jsonPath.substring(2);
135      if (pathWithoutRoot.isEmpty()) {
136        return new ArrayList<>();
137      }
138      return Arrays.asList(pathWithoutRoot.split("\\."));
139    }
140
141    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid JSON path format: " + jsonPath);
142  }
143
144  private List<String> parseComplexJsonPath(String jsonPath) {
145    // For paths with array syntax like $[*].name or $.users[0].name
146    // Keep them as single segments to maintain compatibility
147    // The actual array handling is done in JsonFilterCommand
148    return List.of(jsonPath);
149  }
150
151  private List<String> parseXmlPathToSegments(String xmlPath) {
152    // Remove leading and trailing slashes without regex to avoid polynomial complexity
153    String normalizedPath = removeLeadingTrailingSlashes(xmlPath);
154    if (normalizedPath.isEmpty()) {
155      return new ArrayList<>();
156    }
157
158    // Split by single slash and filter empty segments to handle multiple consecutive slashes
159    List<String> segments = new ArrayList<>();
160    int start = 0;
161    for (int i = 0; i <= normalizedPath.length(); i++) {
162      if (i == normalizedPath.length() || normalizedPath.charAt(i) == '/') {
163        if (i > start) {
164          segments.add(normalizedPath.substring(start, i));
165        }
166        start = i + 1;
167      }
168    }
169
170    return segments;
171  }
172
173  /**
174   * Removes leading and trailing slashes from path without regex
175   *
176   * @param path the input path
177   * @return path with leading/trailing slashes removed
178   */
179  private String removeLeadingTrailingSlashes(String path) {
180    if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) {
181      return "";
182    }
183
184    int start = 0;
185    int end = path.length();
186
187    // Remove leading slashes
188    while (start < end && path.charAt(start) == '/') {
189      start++;
190    }
191
192    // Remove trailing slashes
193    while (end > start && path.charAt(end - 1) == '/') {
194      end--;
195    }
196
197    return path.substring(start, end);
198  }
199
200  @Override
201  public String toString() {
202    return originalPath;
203  }
204
205  @Override
206  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
207    if (this == obj) return true;
208    if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
209    TreePath treePath = (TreePath) obj;
210    return Objects.equals(pathSegmentsList, treePath.pathSegmentsList);
211  }
212
213  @Override
214  public int hashCode() {
215    return Objects.hash(pathSegmentsList);
216  }
217}
